name: Mehai Technology Limited
about: Mehai Technology Limited engages in trading, dealing, installation, commission, maintaining and repairing all kinds of electrical and electronic goods. It operates through electrical and electronic goods, preform caps, alkaline water caps, packaging materials related to food and beverages, agricultural products and allied items; and Providing IT and IT-enabled services segments. The company also engages in turnkey solutions for solar energy systems, solar powered batteries and related technologies, battery energy storage system and related components. It also offers refrigerators, air conditioner, cooler, laptop, television, audio, washing machine, and mobile products. In addition, the company is involved in manufacturing mineral water. Further, its products are used in residential, commercial, industrial, infrastructure, telecommunications, data centers and renewable-energy applications. Mehai Technology Limited was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Kolkata, India.
